draw_detection_bboxes_on_image: draw bounding boxes and class labels with optional segmentation masks on an image using imshow_det_bboxes
visualize_gt_and_detection_results: visualize ground truth and detection bounding boxes side by side on an image using imshow_gt_det_bboxes
convert_bgr_to_rgb_matplotlib: convert a BGR color value to a normalized RGB tuple for matplotlib using color_val_matplotlib
filter_bboxes_by_score_threshold: filter bounding boxes by confidence score threshold when drawing detections with imshow_det_bboxes
save_visualized_detection_image: save an image with drawn bounding boxes and labels to a file using the out_file parameter
